name: Bugcrowd
description: Crowdsourced security platform where Application Security Engineers triage all submissions using a Vulnerability Rating Taxonomy (VRT). Researchers ranked by accuracy, vulnerability counts, priority percentile, and severity.

peerReview.processDescription: All submissions triaged by Application Security Engineers (ASEs) using VRT. Submissions pass through New to Triaged to Accepted/Rejected. AI Triage Assistant assists but human analysts make final decisions.

attribution.attributionNotes: Public leaderboard, achievement badges, Hall of Fame per program, performance metrics.

povsAlignment.description: Vulnerability disclosure platform with VRT-based triage and public researcher leaderboards.
